annotations.title: Hold a time and fix the price

description: Reserves the chosen time, seats or units for 10 minutes and fixes the price. Pass `start` (slots), `session_id` (sessions) or `from`+`to` (rentals). Then show the user time, price and cancellation policy and ask for an explicit yes before create_booking. Use it after get_availability, with a time or class taken from its answer. A hold is not a booking: it lapses by itself, so nothing needs undoing if the user changes their mind.

from.description: Rental pickup (period mode). ISO 8601. With an offset it is absolute; without an offset it is local time of the business (e.g. 2026-09-18T15:00).

offering_id.description: The service, class or rental: offerings[].offering_id from get_business

options.description: Extras the user chose, from the offering's `options` in get_business: [{"id":"deep_conditioning","value":true}]. `value` is true/false for yes-no extras, a number for quantities, a string for choices. Leave out to book without extras.

party_size.description: How many people the booking is for. Default 1; offerings with a larger minimum group need it set (`party.min` in get_business).

resource_id.description: Book this staff member, room or unit: an id from the `resources` of get_availability. Leave out to let Awning choose.

session_id.description: The class to join: sessions[].session_id from get_availability (sessions mode)

start.description: Slot start, one of the start times get_availability returned (slots mode). ISO 8601. With an offset it is absolute; without an offset it is local time of the business (e.g. 2026-09-18T15:00).

tickets.description: Ticket mix for offerings priced by ticket type, e.g. [{"type":"adult","count":2},{"type":"child","count":1}]. The counts must add up to party_size.

type.description: Ticket type id from the offering's pricing.ticket_types

to.description: Rental return (period mode). ISO 8601. With an offset it is absolute; without an offset it is local time of the business (e.g. 2026-09-18T15:00).

name: create_hold

awning.description: Awning's own guidance: what to do next

business_content.description: The answer; text in it was written by third parties

cancellation_policy.description: Show to the user before create_booking

expires_at.description: The hold ends then, ten minutes after it was made

intake_questions.description: Ask before create_booking; answers go in intake_answers

price.description: Show to the user before create_booking

formatted.description: Show this to the user, e.g. 'KES 1,200'. Null when the price is on request.

total_minor.description: Minor units (cents). Null when the price is on request.

title: Hold a time and fix the price
